milestone: Package 12: dockerfile-check shipped; kit at 12 packages, 85 tests

package.name: dsh-dockerfile-check
package.decides: Dockerfile text: pinned base image, non-root USER, no letter-value secrets in layers, COPY over ADD for plain copies, package-manager cleanup, WORKDIR
package.distinct_rule: case-insensitive instructions with backslash continuations treated as one instruction reported at its first line — a multi-line apt-get install is one finding, not three
package.exemptions_that_matter: a @sha256: digest counts as pinned; ${VAR} references are not literals; tarballs and URLs are legitimate ADD sources

quality_bar: 85 tests across the kit (12 new, all green on the first run), audit 12/12 clean, site 13 pages with verbatim output, npm 0.1.0 live
